<thought>To locate the template that generates the listed precursors from the target alkene, I will search the template catalog using functional groups that are broken and formed in the Still‑Gennari reaction. The forward reaction breaks a C‑C double bond (alkene) and forms an aldehyde carbonyl. These correspond to the available functional‑group names “C‑C double bonds” (broken) and “aldehydes” (formed). I will query the catalog with these criteria and a small limit.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aldehydes"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
